description: NO AUTH / PUBLIC / READ-ONLY. Resolves a weather concept to validated native variables/expressions and an exact or approximate match label. Use resolved_request directly in /timeseries or /runs; read resolved_match for height differences and native statistics. Use this first for common natural-language concepts such as 2 metre temperature or 10 metre wind instead of guessing dataset-native codes such as TMP.

alias.description: Optional output alias for the resolved request.

dataset.description: Optional dataset code to resolve the shared parameter against.

parameter.description: Shared parameter code, for example temperature_2m, wind_speed_10m, mean_sea_level_pressure, or wind_speed_500hpa.

name: gribstream_resolve_shared_parameter

outputSchema.description: Resolved shared parameter request fragments for a dataset.

title: Resolve shared weather parameter
